segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My first reaction was 'there it is again' ... the seepage rate was within MEL tolerance historically ... we were also five days from a contractual deadline ... I wanted to move quickly.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Eligible rationale about initial reaction, tolerance history, and urgency, but not itself a complete hidden manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once I saw the third one lined up with the first two, it read to me as confirmation ... I deferred it under MEL rather than pulling it into an unscheduled inspection.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats a third recurrence as a meaningful benign pattern and uses that perceived pattern to justify deferral.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: expert evidence weighting and risk continuity judgment
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Tomas ... says it's the same seepage pattern ... this fitting type 'just seeps, it doesn't fail badly' ... that carries weight ... the junior engineer's torque and seal check felt like duplicating effort.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The same decision episode contains both the continuity assumption about benign fitting behavior and tenure-based substitution of expert judgment for structured analysis.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Green status for that defect category, fleet-wide ... I referenced it directly in the disposition memo ... I didn't dig into the calculation.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The fleet-average dashboard is accepted as authoritative without checking tail-specific recurrence coverage.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Between the dashboard and Tomas's read, everything was pointing the same direction ... it felt like two independent checks agreeing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Confidence is increased by apparent convergence of sources that were not independently validated against the tail-specific history.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: MRO's engineering support had already left ... the seepage was still within tolerance ... I authorized release to service ... flagged a borescope recheck ... but didn't make it mandatory before dispatch.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an eligible release rationale, but the hidden manifestations are mapped to the later self-assessment and aircraft-specific outcome projection.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Other managers might let a deadline push them into a call they're not comfortable with. I don't think that happened here ... the schedule was in the background ... I don't experience it as something that colors my technical judgment.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant generalizes susceptibility to deadline pressure to other managers while exempting the own final technical judgment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Fifteen years at this airline, and I've never seen this exact fitting fail badly on any tail. That history made me comfortable that this one would be fine, even with the root cause investigation still technically open.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Failure-free personal history is projected onto this unresolved aircraft-specific case as confidence in a favorable outcome.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd probably push harder for that fault-tree analysis ... not treat the recurrence pattern alone as settling the question ... a smooth return ... doesn't really tell us whether the process behind it was solid.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Retrospective correction is eligible context but is not credited as a contemporaneous hidden manifestation.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding moderate-confidence findings raises segment hits from 2 to 4 and mechanism-first instance true positives from 2 to 4; strict true positives rise from 0 to 1.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Candidate inclusion adds no true positives, one duplicate, and one negative-segment false alarm; mechanism-first F1 falls from 0.7273 to 0.6154.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 4 of 6 positive segments with no false alarms, yielding hit rate 0.6667 and F1 0.8.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance identification is weak: 1 of 7 hidden instances is matched, with precision 0.25, recall 0.1429, and F1 0.1818 at high_and_moderate.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first performance is materially stronger: 4 of 7 hidden mechanisms are matched with no false positives, yielding precision 1, recall 0.5714, and F1 0.7273 at high_and_moderate.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates provide one plausible sparse-pattern near miss and one useful abstention, but neither adds a true positive; inclusion adds one duplicate and one false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor labels replace three hidden target labels: apophenia or correlation bias, experience bias, and optimism bias.
The single confirmation-bias finding conflates recurrence-pattern and source-convergence evidence, leaving Illusion of Validity undetected under one-to-one matching.
Normalcy Bias and Bias Blind Spot are omitted.
Candidate inclusion introduces a false alarm for plan continuation on a negative segment.
main_strengths: Interview quotations are valid and generally localized to the correct reasoning episodes.
The mechanisms for sparse recurrence inference, seniority-based deference, automation under-verification, and favorable-outcome projection are captured.
The system appropriately keeps two speculative possibilities as candidates rather than identified findings.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has good segment-level sensitivity at high_and_moderate and strong mechanism-first precision, but substantially lower strict performance because several labels are near neighbors rather than approved equivalents and several hidden instances are missed or conflated.
